description.value: A controlled functional MRI investigation of mindfulness-based cognitive therapy effects in patients with bipolar disorder, including whole-brain group comparisons during a mindfulness meditation task before and after an eight-week intervention.

spans.text: In this study, we further investigated the effects of MBCT in bipolar disorder, in a controlled fMRI study.

value: We hypothesized improvements in cognitive function, clinical measures of mindfulness, and mood and anxiety symptoms, and increased activations in midline cortical regions in bipolar disorder patients, following an eight-week MBCT intervention.

spans.text: We hypothesized improvements in cognitive function, clinical measures of mindfulness, and mood and anxiety symptoms, and increased activations in midline cortical regions in bipolar disorder patients, following an eight-week MBCT intervention.
